# Breadcrumb

## Breadcrumb

A `nav` landmark holding an ordered list of `li` items: links through
`ctx.Registry.Link`, the current page `aria-current="page"` in
`color.breadcrumb_current`, the `/` separator in
`color.breadcrumb_separator` at the `control.breadcrumb_gap` (`_small`)
gap after every item but the last. `BreadcrumbItem` renders the item;
`BreadcrumbSkeleton` renders the shimmer bars with the same separators
and no landmark.

### Decisions

- **`requires_parent`: BreadcrumbItem must be composed inside Breadcrumb; its standalone render is for the showcase and the gates only.**
- **The overflow is a composed `ctx.Registry.OverflowMenu`.** The
  breadcrumb trigger's box, glyph offset, ink, focus underline, menu
  offset, caret and connector suppression are composition props on
  OverflowMenu (`triggerWidth`/`triggerHeight`, `icon`, `iconOffset`,
  `iconColor`/`iconHoverLeaf`/`iconActiveLeaf`, `focusRingLeaf`,
  `focusUnderline`, `menuOffset`, `caret`, `connector`), not a variant.
- **The small link's minimum width is a Link composition prop.** `minWidth`
  applies to the link's face; the pressable grows to cover it.
- **The current page is text, not a link.** Upstream's current item is a
  link-class span with `aria-current`; ours draws link-styled text in
  `color.breadcrumb_current` with no underline and no link semantics.
- **BreadcrumbItem** (requires_parent): requires_parent: "must be composed inside Breadcrumb; measured through Breadcrumb's samples."

## Breadcrumb

Breadcrumb is a component in the Breadcrumb family.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `array` | yes | The trail: `{ label, href, isCurrentPage, onPress, visited }` entries, or `{ overflow: [{ label, href, onPress }] }` for the overflow menu. |
| `noTrailingSlash` | `boolean` | no | Draws no separator after the last item. |
| `size` | `string` | no | One of `variants`: `md` (the default) or `sm` - the breadcrumb type and gaps. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | no | The nav landmark's name. Default `Breadcrumb`. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `caretSize` | `control.breadcrumb_overflow_caret_size` |
| `gap` | `control.breadcrumb_gap` |
| `gapSmall` | `control.breadcrumb_gap_small` |
| `linkMinWidthSmall` | `control.breadcrumb_link_min_width_small` |
| `overflowHeight` | `control.breadcrumb_overflow_height` |
| `overflowHeightSmall` | `control.breadcrumb_overflow_height_small` |
| `overflowIconOffset` | `control.breadcrumb_overflow_icon_offset` |
| `overflowUnderlineWidth` | `control.breadcrumb_overflow_underline_width` |
| `overflowWidth` | `control.breadcrumb_overflow_width` |

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"items":[{"href":"#home","label":"Home"},{"href":"#products","label":"Products"},{"isCurrentPage":true,"label":"Product A"}]}` |
| noTrailingSlash | `{"items":[{"href":"#home","label":"Home"},{"href":"#products","label":"Products"},{"isCurrentPage":true,"label":"Product A"}],"noTrailingSlash":true}` |
| small | `{"items":[{"href":"#home","label":"Home"},{"href":"#products","label":"Products"},{"isCurrentPage":true,"label":"Product A"}],"size":"sm"}` |
| overflow | `{"items":[{"href":"#home","label":"Home"},{"overflow":[{"href":"#category","label":"Category"},{"href":"#sub-category","label":"Sub-category"}]},{"isCurrentPage":true,"label":"Product A"}]}` |
| overflowSmall | `{"items":[{"href":"#home","label":"Home"},{"overflow":[{"href":"#category","label":"Category"},{"href":"#sub-category","label":"Sub-category"}]},{"isCurrentPage":true,"label":"Product A"}],"size":"sm"}` |

## BreadcrumbItem

BreadcrumbItem is a component in the Breadcrumb family; it must be composed inside Breadcrumb.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `none` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | `no_reference` - no upstream visual reference; gates are structural, accessibility and cross-template; `requires_parent` - renders only inside its parent |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | no | The link text; absent for an overflow item. |
| `href` | `string` | no | The destination the link carries; an item without one is link-styled text. |
| `onPress` | `function` | no | Called on activation. |
| `visited` | `boolean` | no | Draws the link's visited color. |
| `isCurrentPage` | `boolean` | no | The current page: `aria-current="page"`, `color.breadcrumb_current`, no underline. |
| `overflow` | `array` | no | `[{ label, href, onPress }]` - composes an OverflowMenu of those options instead of a link. |
| `last` | `boolean` | no | Composition prop: the last item draws no separator. |
| `noTrailingSlash` | `boolean` | no | Composition prop: draws no separator. |
| `size` | `string` | no | Composition prop: `sm` or `md`, from Breadcrumb. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `caretSize` | `control.breadcrumb_overflow_caret_size` |
| `gap` | `control.breadcrumb_gap` |
| `iconSize` | `size.icon_01` |
| `gapSmall` | `control.breadcrumb_gap_small` |
| `linkMinWidthSmall` | `control.breadcrumb_link_min_width_small` |
| `overflowHeight` | `control.breadcrumb_overflow_height` |
| `overflowHeightSmall` | `control.breadcrumb_overflow_height_small` |
| `overflowIconOffset` | `control.breadcrumb_overflow_icon_offset` |
| `overflowUnderlineWidth` | `control.breadcrumb_overflow_underline_width` |
| `overflowWidth` | `control.breadcrumb_overflow_width` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"href":"#home","label":"Home"}` |
